name: Section container
summary: The outer wrapper for every landing section: a full-bleed background band with its content centred and capped at the landing content width (1280px), carrying the standard vertical rhythm. Section sequence: coloured bands (soft or primary) never sit next to each other; a full white section always sits between them, and white padding alone does not count. At most two primary-colour bands per page. The first band (hero) is white. Grounds directly on the live marketing site (max-width 1280px, section padding ~64/32); framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Outer wrapper for every landing section
Full-bleed band, content centred and capped at 1280px
Standard vertical rhythm; soft and dark variants never touch, a white section always sits between them
At most two primary-colour bands per page; the first band (hero) is white
html:
Section container

A band that spans full width, with its content centred

The section paints its background edge to edge; the inner column caps the reading width at the landing content max-width and carries the standard vertical rhythm. Add a modifier for a soft or dark band, and keep a full white section between any two coloured bands.

Soft band

The same container, tinted. Never place it next to another coloured band; a full white section sits between them.

White section between

A full white section always separates two coloured bands.

Dark band

The same container on the dark surface token, for a high-contrast section. Use at most two primary-colour bands per page, never beside another coloured band.
